PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-000.Description: PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice presence in a FOCUS dataset is defined as follows

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-001.Description: PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST be present in a FOCUS dataset when the provider supports prices in virtual currency and publishes unit prices exclusive of discounts

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-002.Description: PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice is RECOMMENDED to be present in a FOCUS dataset when the provider supports pricing and billing in different currencies and publishes unit prices exclusive of discounts

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-003.Description: PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MAY be present in a FOCUS dataset in all other cases

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-004.Description: PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST be of type Decimal

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-005.Description: PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST conform to NumericFormat requirements

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-006.Description: PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice nullability is defined as follows

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-007.Description: PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST be null when ChargeCategory is 'Tax'

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-008.Condition: ChargeCategory is 'Usage' or 'Purchase' and ChargeClass is not 'Correction'
PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-008.Description: PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST NOT be null when ChargeCategory is 'Usage' or 'Purchase' and ChargeClass is not 'Correction'

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-009.Description: PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MAY be null in all other cases

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-010.Description: When PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice is not null, PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice adheres to the following additional requirements

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-011.Description: PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST be a non-negative decimal value

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-012.Description: PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice MUST be denominated in the PricingCurrency

PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-013.Description: Discrepancies in PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice, ContractedCost, or PricingQuantity MAY exist when ChargeClass is 'Correction'
